## TRA Timeline

#### Announcement of business combination

- 2018-10-18: Transaction Agreement and Plan of Merger signed with Strike Capital, LLC; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit E at 85% sharing rate covering Section 754 step-ups from exchanges of Company Units

#### Termination

- 2019-02-12: Transaction Agreement and all ancillary agreements (including the form-of TRA) terminated by mutual agreement; reported in 8-K Item 1.02
- 2019-11-07: Sentinel fails to consummate an alternative business combination by its charter deadline and enters liquidation

## Explanation

Sentinel Energy Services Inc. was a SPAC that announced an Up-C business combination with Strike Capital, LLC on October 18, 2018, with a contemplated Tax Receivable Agreement (Exhibit E to the Transaction Agreement) at the standard 85% rate. The form-of TRA was never executed: the Transaction Agreement was terminated by mutual agreement on February 12, 2019, and the form-of TRA terminated automatically in accordance with its own terms. Sentinel then failed to find an alternative target by its November 7, 2019 charter deadline and entered liquidation. See `contract_log.md` for the form-of contract text and the termination 8-K reference.
